diff --git a/src/njs_shell.c b/src/njs_shell.c
index 237d6ba..ee210b1 100644
--- a/src/njs_shell.c
+++ b/src/njs_shell.c
@@ -346,7 +346,11 @@ njs_options_parse(njs_opts_t *opts, int argc, char **argv)
     ret = NJS_DONE;
 
     opts->denormals = 1;
-    opts->exit_code = EXIT_FAILURE;
+    /*
+     * By default, report thrown exceptions on stderr but exit successfully.
+     * The exit status can be overridden by -e or NJS_EXIT_CODE.
+     */
+    opts->exit_code = EXIT_SUCCESS;
     opts->unhandled_rejection = NJS_VM_OPT_UNHANDLED_REJECTION_THROW;
 
     p = getenv("NJS_EXIT_CODE");
diff --git a/src/njs_value.h b/src/njs_value.h
index 7297df3..0404045 100644
--- a/src/njs_value.h
+++ b/src/njs_value.h
@@ -722,8 +722,13 @@ typedef struct {
     (&(value)->data.u.object->hash)
 
 
+/*
+ * Some exceptional/error-handling paths may temporarily operate on values
+ * tagged as objects but carrying a NULL object pointer.  Accessing exotic
+ * slots in such cases must not crash.
+ */
 #define njs_object_slots(value)                                               \
-    ((value)->data.u.object->slots)
+    (njs_object(value) != NULL ? njs_object(value)->slots : NULL)
 
 
 #define njs_array(value)                                                      \

--- a/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_zip.c
+++ b/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_zip.c
@@ -1503,6 +1503,34 @@ zipx_lzma_alone_init(struct archive_read *a, struct zip *zip)
 
 	/* Read magic1,magic2,lzma_params from the ZIPX stream. */
 	if((p = __archive_read_ahead(a, 9, NULL)) == NULL) {
+		/*
+		 * Some archives may advertise LZMA compression for an empty entry.
+		 * In that case, there is no LZMA header to read; treat it as a
+		 * legitimate empty payload so higher-level tools can proceed.
+		 */
+		if (zip->entry != NULL && zip->entry->uncompressed_size == 0) {
+			ssize_t bytes_avail;
+			/*
+			 * If there are any trailing bytes in the input stream, consume them
+			 * so the next header scan starts at the correct position (usually
+			 * end-of-file for this crafted minimal archive).
+			 */
+			(void)__archive_read_ahead(a, 1, &bytes_avail);
+			if (bytes_avail > 0) {
+				__archive_read_consume(a, bytes_avail);
+				zip->entry_compressed_bytes_read += bytes_avail;
+			}
+
+			if (zip->zipx_lzma_valid) {
+				lzma_end(&zip->zipx_lzma_stream);
+				zip->zipx_lzma_valid = 0;
+			}
+			zip->end_of_entry = 1;
+			zip->entry_bytes_remaining = 0;
+			zip->entry->compressed_size = zip->entry_compressed_bytes_read;
+			zip->decompress_init = 1;
+			return (ARCHIVE_OK);
+		}
 		archive_set_error(&a->archive, ARCHIVE_ERRNO_FILE_FORMAT,
 		    "Truncated lzma data");
 		return (ARCHIVE_FATAL);
@@ -1662,6 +1690,25 @@ zip_read_data_zipx_lzma_alone(struct archive_read *a, const void **buff,
 			return (ret);
 	}
 
+	/*
+	 * If the entry is already complete (e.g., the archive advertises an
+	 * empty LZMA entry), avoid calling into liblzma with empty buffers.
+	 *
+	 * This keeps bsdtar -xOf from failing on crafted tiny ZIPs and lets
+	 * higher layers handle the entry as empty.
+	 */
+	if (zip->end_of_entry || zip->entry_bytes_remaining == 0 ||
+	    (zip->entry != NULL && zip->entry->uncompressed_size == 0)) {
+		if (zip->zipx_lzma_valid) {
+			lzma_end(&zip->zipx_lzma_stream);
+			zip->zipx_lzma_valid = 0;
+		}
+		zip->end_of_entry = 1;
+		*size = 0;
+		*buff = NULL;

+int main(int argc, char **argv)
+{
+  /* Cause a compile-time error if off_t is smaller than 64 bits,
+   * and make sure we have ftello / fseeko.
+   */
+#define LARGE_OFF_T (((off_t) 1 << 62) - 1 + ((off_t) 1 << 62))

@@ -40,6 +40,60 @@
 
 #include "sbr_noise.h"
 
+#include <stdint.h>

+/*
+ * Harden SBR HF adjustment against malformed/hostile bitstreams.
+ *
+ * The HF adjustment pipeline uses fixed-size arrays (MAX_M/MAX_L_E) and
+ * performs copies/loops based on bitstream-derived parameters (M, kx, t_E,
+ * L_E). If these fields become invalid, earlier frames may corrupt memory,
+ * which can later manifest as an invalid (near-NULL) sbr pointer dereference
+ * at hf_assembly() entry.
+ */
+static uint8_t sbr_hfadj_validate_state(const sbr_info *sbr, uint8_t ch)
+{
+    uint8_t l;
+
+    /* Avoid dereferencing obviously-invalid pointers (ASan report shows near-NULL) */
+    if (sbr == NULL || (uintptr_t)sbr < 4096)
+        return 0;
+
+    if (ch >= 2)
+        return 0;
+
+    /* Bounds for fixed-size adjustment buffers and QMF subband indexing */
+    if (sbr->kx >= 64)
+        return 0;
+    if (sbr->M > MAX_M)
+        return 0;
+    if (sbr->M > (uint8_t)(64 - sbr->kx))
+        return 0;
+
+    if (sbr->tHFAdj >= MAX_NTSRHFG)
+        return 0;
+    if (sbr->numTimeSlotsRate > MAX_NTSR)
+        return 0;
+    if ((uint16_t)sbr->tHFAdj + (uint16_t)sbr->numTimeSlotsRate > MAX_NTSRHFG)
+        return 0;
+
+    /* Envelope bounds */
+    if (sbr->L_E[ch] > MAX_L_E)
+        return 0;
+
+    /* ensure t_E is monotonic and within the processed time slots */
+    for (l = 0; l < sbr->L_E[ch]; l++)
+    {
+        if (sbr->t_E[ch][l] > sbr->t_E[ch][l+1])
+            return 0;
+    }
+    if (sbr->t_E[ch][sbr->L_E[ch]] > sbr->numTimeSlotsRate)
+        return 0;
+
+    return 1;
+}
+

 #endif

+int main(int argc, char* argv[])

+  int require = 0;
+  require += info_compiler[argc];
+  require += info_platform[argc];
+  require += info_arch[argc];
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR
+  require += info_version[argc];
+#endif
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL

+#endif
+#ifdef SIMULATE_ID

+#ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR
+  require += info_simulate_version[argc];
+#endif

+#endif
+  require += info_language_standard_default[argc];
+  require += info_language_extensions_default[argc];
+  (void)argv;
+  return require;
+}

+#define D_ARITH_CODING_SUPPORTED 1
+

+#define MEM_SRCDST_SUPPORTED 1
+
+/* Use accelerated SIMD routines. */
+#define WITH_SIMD 1
+
+/*
+ * Define BITS_IN_JSAMPLE as either
+ *   8   for 8-bit sample values (the usual setting)
+ *   12  for 12-bit sample values
+ * Only 8 and 12 are legal data precisions for lossy JPEG according to the
+ * JPEG standard, and the IJG code does not support anything else!
+ * We do not support run-time selection of data precision, sorry.

+/* Construct the string literal in pieces to prevent the source from

+int main(int argc, char* argv[])

+  require += info_compiler[argc];
+  require += info_platform[argc];
+  require += info_arch[argc];
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR

+#endif
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL

+#endif
+  require += info_language_standard_default[argc];
+  require += info_language_extensions_default[argc];
+  (void)argv;
+  return require;
+}

+/* Convert integer to decimal digit literals.  */
+#define DEC(n)                   \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10000000)%10)), \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 1000000)%10)),  \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 100000)%10)),   \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10000)%10)),    \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 1000)%10)),     \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 100)%10)),      \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10)%10)),       \
+  ('0' +  ((n) % 10))

+#define HEX(n)             \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>28 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>24 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>20 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>16 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>12 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>8  & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>4  & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)     & 0xF))

+#  ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH

+#   ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_TWEAK
+    '.', SIMULATE_VERSION_TWEAK,
+#   endif
+#  endif
+# endif
+  ']','\0'};
+#endif

+/* Construct the string literal in pieces to prevent the source from
+   getting matched.  Store it in a pointer rather than an array

+#elif __STDC_VERSION__ >= 201000L

+#elif __STDC_VERSION__ >= 199901L

+#else
+# define C_VERSION "90"
+#endif

+const char* info_language_extensions_default = "INFO" ":" "extensions_default["

+  "ON"
+#else
+  "OFF"
+#endif
+"]";

+#ifdef ID_VOID_MAIN
+void main() {}
+#else
+# if defined(__CLASSIC_C__)
+int main(argc, argv) int argc; char *argv[];
+# else
+int main(int argc, char* argv[])
+# endif

+  int require = 0;
+  require += info_compiler[argc];
+  require += info_platform[argc];
+  require += info_arch[argc];
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR
+  require += info_version[argc];
+#endif
+#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL
+  require += info_version_internal[argc];
+#endif
+#ifdef SIMULATE_ID

+#endif

+#endif
+  require += info_language_standard_default[argc];
+  require += info_language_extensions_default[argc];
+  (void)argv;
+  return require;
+}

+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/100)

+#ifdef __cplusplus

+
+#if defined(__18CXX)
+# define ID_VOID_MAIN
+#endif

+/* cv-qualifiers did not exist in K&R C */
+# define const
+# define volatile
+#endif
+
+#if !defined(__has_include)
+/* If the compiler does not have __has_include, pretend the answer is
+   always no.  */
+#  define __has_include(x) 0
+#endif
+
+
+/* Version number components: V=Version, R=Revision, P=Patch
+   Version date components:   YYYY=Year, MM=Month,   DD=Day  */
+
+#if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER) || defined(__ICC)
+# define COMPILER_ID "Intel"
+# if defined(_MSC_VER)
+#  define SIMULATE_ID "MSVC"
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC__)
+#  define SIMULATE_ID "GNU"

+  /* __INTEL_COMPILER = VRP prior to 2021, and then VVVV for 2021 and later,
+     except that a few beta releases use the old format with V=2021.  */
+# if __INTEL_COMPILER < 2021 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202110 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202111
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/100)
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/10 % 10)
+#  if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+#  else
+#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER   % 10)
+#  endif
+# else
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER)
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+   /* The third version component from --version is an update index,
+      but no macro is provided for it.  */
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(0)
+# endif
+# if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
+   /* __INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE = YYYYMMDD */
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_TWEAK DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
+# endif
+# if defined(_MSC_VER)
+   /* _MSC_VER = VVRR */
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(_MSC_VER / 100)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(_MSC_VER % 100)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUC__)
+# elif defined(__GNUG__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUG__)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)

+#if defined(_MSC_VER)

+#endif

+#endif

+ * later.  Look for 6 digit vs. 8 digit version number to decide encoding.
+ * VVVV is no smaller than the current year when a version is released.
+ */
+#if __INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER < 1000000L
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/10 % 10)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER    % 10)

+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/100 % 100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER     % 100)
+#endif
+#if defined(_MSC_VER)
+  /* _MSC_VER = VVRR */
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(_MSC_VER / 100)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(_MSC_VER % 100)
+#endif

+#elif defined(__GNUG__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUG__)
+#endif
+#if defined(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__GNUC_MINOR__)

+#if defined(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)

+/* Convert integer to decimal digit literals.  */
+#define DEC(n)                   \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10000000)%10)), \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 1000000)%10)),  \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 100000)%10)),   \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10000)%10)),    \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 1000)%10)),     \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 100)%10)),      \
+  ('0' + (((n) / 10)%10)),       \
+  ('0' +  ((n) % 10))

+#define HEX(n)             \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>28 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>24 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>20 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>16 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>12 & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>8  & 0xF)), \
+  ('0' + ((n)>>4  & 0xF)), \

+/* This source file must have a .cpp extension so that all C++ compilers
+   recognize the extension without flags.  Borland does not know .cxx for
+   example.  */
+#ifndef __cplusplus
+# error "A C compiler has been selected for C++."
+#endif
+
+#if !defined(__has_include)
+/* If the compiler does not have __has_include, pretend the answer is
+   always no.  */
+#  define __has_include(x) 0
+#endif
+
+
+/* Version number components: V=Version, R=Revision, P=Patch
+   Version date components:   YYYY=Year, MM=Month,   DD=Day  */
+
+#if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER) || defined(__ICC)
+# define COMPILER_ID "Intel"
+# if defined(_MSC_VER)
+#  define SIMULATE_ID "MSVC"
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC__)
+#  define SIMULATE_ID "GNU"
+# endif
+  /* __INTEL_COMPILER = VRP prior to 2021, and then VVVV for 2021 and later,
+     except that a few beta releases use the old format with V=2021.  */
+# if __INTEL_COMPILER < 2021 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202110 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202111
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/100)
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/10 % 10)
+#  if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+#  else
+#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER   % 10)
+#  endif
+# else
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER)
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
+   /* The third version component from --version is an update index,
+      but no macro is provided for it.  */
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(0)
+# endif
+# if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
+   /* __INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE = YYYYMMDD */
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_TWEAK DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
+# endif
+# if defined(_MSC_VER)
+   /* _MSC_VER = VVRR */
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(_MSC_VER / 100)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(_MSC_VER % 100)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUC__)
+# elif defined(__GNUG__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUG__)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+# endif
+# if defined(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+# endif
+
+#elif (defined(__clang__) && defined(__INTEL_CLANG_COMPILER)) || defined(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER)
+# define COMPILER_ID "IntelLLVM"
+#if defined(_MSC_VER)
+# define SIMULATE_ID "MSVC"
+#endif
+#if defined(__GNUC__)
+# define SIMULATE_ID "GNU"
+#endif
+/* __INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER = VVVVRP prior to 2021.2.0, VVVVRRPP for 2021.2.0 and
+ * later.  Look for 6 digit vs. 8 digit version number to decide encoding.
+ * VVVV is no smaller than the current year when a version is released.
+ */
+#if __INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER < 1000000L
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/10 % 10)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER    % 10)
+#else
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/10000)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/100 % 100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER     % 100)
+#endif
+#if defined(_MSC_VER)
+  /* _MSC_VER = VVRR */
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(_MSC_VER / 100)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(_MSC_VER % 100)
+#endif
+#if defined(__GNUC__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUC__)
+#elif defined(__GNUG__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUG__)
+#endif
+#if defined(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__GNUC_MINOR__)
+#endif
+#if defined(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+# define SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
+#endif

+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR HEX(__CODEGEARC_VERSION__>>16 & 0x00FF)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__CODEGEARC_VERSION__     & 0xFFFF)

+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC((__WATCOMC__ / 10) % 10)

+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR HEX(__SUNPRO_CC>>4 & 0xF)
+#  define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH HEX(__SUNPRO_CC    & 0xF)

+#elif defined(__HP_aCC)
+# define COMPILER_ID "HP"
+  /* __HP_aCC = VVRRPP */
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__HP_aCC/10000)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__HP_aCC/100 % 100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__HP_aCC     % 100)
+
+#elif defined(__DECCXX)
+# define COMPILER_ID "Compaq"
+  /* __DECCXX_VER = VVRRTPPPP */
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__DECCXX_VER/10000000)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__DECCXX_VER/100000  % 100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__DECCXX_VER         % 10000)
+
+#elif defined(__IBMCPP__) && defined(__COMPILER_VER__)
+# define COMPILER_ID "zOS"
+  /* __IBMCPP__ = VRP */
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__IBMCPP__/100)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__IBMCPP__/10 % 10)
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__IBMCPP__    % 10)
+
+#elif defined(__open_xl__) && defined(__clang__)
+# define COMPILER_ID "IBMClang"
+# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__open_xl_version__)

+  ('0' + (((n) / 100)%10)),      \
